issues.description: project_id is interpolated into the URL without path-segment encoding, allowing slashes, .., or ? to change the requested endpoint.
batch_create interpolates project_id directly into the URL, creating the same endpoint manipulation risk.
list_for_task interpolates task_id directly into the URL, so crafted IDs can escape the intended task annotations path.
review interpolates annotation_id directly into the URL, so crafted IDs can alter the review endpoint or query string.
Retry handling only covers HTTP responses; transient httpx transport errors and timeouts are not retried and leak raw exceptions.
Retry-After only accepts numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date values.
Project pagination silently skips malformed items instead of raising a schema/API contract error.
batch_create eagerly materializes the entire iterable, contradicting the any-number-of-tasks API and risking high memory use.
batch_create silently drops malformed result entries and does not validate result count or index coverage.
Annotation pagination silently skips malformed items instead of surfacing bad API data.
Project.from_dict does not runtime-validate Literal fields, so invalid statuses are accepted as typed values.
Task.from_dict accepts invalid task states despite the TaskState Literal type.
BatchCreateResult.from_dict accepts invalid batch statuses despite the BatchStatus Literal type.
ReviewResult.from_dict accepts invalid verdicts despite the ReviewVerdict Literal type.
Frozen TaskCreate stores and returns the mutable payload dict directly, so callers can mutate supposedly immutable model state.
Project declares pytest only; there is no configured linting, type checking, coverage, or CI-facing quality gate.
